summary: Dorchester Minerals, L.P. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 16, 2026 Contribution and Exchange Agreement with Hillside Exploration Assets, LLC to acquire approximately 4,300 net royalty acres in the Williston Basin, North Dakota. Consideration is 1,250,000 common units issued to the Contributor, plus a closing cash payment equal to cash receipts from the Properties from July 1, 2026 onward. No price per share or premium is stated. Closing is expected October 30, 2026, subject to customary conditions; the Contributor is unaffiliated. Watch unit dilution and the cash true-up at closing.
